title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — payout payout limit
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute immediate refund — For a customer requesting the maximum permitted immediate refund, use the same-entity active support tier minimum monthly fee as the immediate payout payout limit; absent active support permits no immediate package payout.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for immediate refund — payout payout limit?**

For a customer requesting the maximum permitted immediate refund, use the same-entity active support tier minimum monthly fee as the immediate payout payout limit; absent active support permits no immediate package payout.

## Contract reference authority

Read the same-entity active support tier numerical commercial parameter for this calculation; do not write support.
